panels.burned_in_description: Endoscopy-system overlay field labels (age, comment, doctor, facility) printed in the frame with no legible values next to them; no date, name or ID is visible.
panels.notes: Viewed on pixels and enlarged: only blank overlay field labels from the endoscopy system are printed; no names, IDs or dates are legible. No genitalia, perineum, anus or breast and no face are visible.
